raw_problem.solution_text:
自旋 $S$ 为 $3 / 2$ 的粒子 $S _ { z }$ 可能的取值为 $\pm 3 / 2$ 和 $\pm 1 / 2$ 所以在 $S _ { z }$ 的表象中 $S _ { z }$ 的四个本征函数为

$$
\left| \begin{array}{c c} \frac {3}{2} & \frac {3}{2} \end{array} \right\rangle = \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 0 \\ 0 \\ 0 \end{array} \right), \quad \left| \begin{array}{c c} \frac {3}{2} & \frac {1}{2} \end{array} \right\rangle = \left( \begin{array}{c} 0 \\ 1 \\ 0 \\ 0 \end{array} \right),
$$

$$
\left| \begin{array}{c c} \frac {3}{2} & - \frac {1}{2} \end{array} \right\rangle = \left( \begin{array}{c} 0 \\ 0 \\ 1 \\ 0 \end{array} \right), \quad \left| \begin{array}{c c} \frac {3}{2} & - \frac {3}{2} \end{array} \right\rangle = \left( \begin{array}{c} 0 \\ 0 \\ 0 \\ 1 \end{array} \right).
$$

由方程 (4.136)

$$
S _ {\pm} \left| s m \right\rangle = \hbar \sqrt {s (s + 1) - m (m \pm 1)} \left| s m \pm 1 \right\rangle ,
$$

得

$$
S _ {+} \left| \frac {3}{2} \frac {3}{2} \right\rangle = 0, \quad S _ {+} \left| \frac {3}{2} \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle = \sqrt {3} \hbar \left| \frac {3}{2} \frac {3}{2} \right\rangle , \quad S _ {+} \left| \frac {3}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle = 2 \hbar \left| \frac {3}{2} \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle ,
$$

$$
S _ {+} \left| \frac {3}{2} - \frac {3}{2} \right\rangle = \sqrt {3} \hbar \left| \frac {3}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle , \quad S _ {-} \left| \frac {3}{2} \frac {3}{2} \right\rangle = \sqrt {3} \hbar \left| \frac {3}{2} \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle ,
$$

$$
S _ {-} \left| \frac {3}{2} \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle = 2 \hbar \left| \frac {3}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle , \quad S _ {-} \left| \frac {3}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle = \sqrt {3} \hbar \left| \frac {3}{2} - \frac {3}{2} \right\rangle , \quad S _ {-} \left| \frac {3}{2} - \frac {3}{2} \right\rangle = 0.
$$

由此可以计算出 $S _ { + }$ $S _ { - }$ 在 $S _ { z }$ 表象中的矩阵(解法同习题 4.34，或者直接求矩阵元)

$$
\boldsymbol {S} _ {+} = \hbar \left( \begin{array}{c c c c} 0 & \sqrt {3} & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & \sqrt {3} \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \end{array} \right), \quad \boldsymbol {S} _ {-} = \hbar \left( \begin{array}{c c c c} 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ \sqrt {3} & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & \sqrt {3} & 0 \end{array} \right).
$$

所以

$$
\boldsymbol {S} _ {x} = \frac {1}{2} \left(\boldsymbol {S} _ {+} + \boldsymbol {S} _ {-}\right) = \frac {1}{2} \hbar \left( \begin{array}{c c c c} 0 & \sqrt {3} & 0 & 0 \\ \sqrt {3} & 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 & \sqrt {3} \\ 0 & 0 & \sqrt {3} & 0 \end{array} \right).
$$

算符 $S _ { x }$ 的本征方程为

$$
\frac {1}{2} \hbar \left( \begin{array}{c c c c} 0 & \sqrt {3} & 0 & 0 \\ \sqrt {3} & 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 & \sqrt {3} \\ 0 & 0 & \sqrt {3} & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} a \\ b \\ c \\ d \end{array} \right) = \frac {1}{2} \hbar \lambda \left( \begin{array}{c} a \\ b \\ c \\ d \end{array} \right),
$$

解久期方程

$$
\left| \begin{array}{c c c c} - \lambda & \sqrt {3} & 0 & 0 \\ \sqrt {3} & - \lambda & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & - \lambda & \sqrt {3} \\ 0 & 0 & \sqrt {3} & - \lambda \end{array} \right| = 0,
$$

$$
\rightarrow \left(\lambda^ {2} - 9\right)\left(\lambda^ {2} - 1\right) = 0 \rightarrow \lambda = \pm 3, \pm 1.
$$

所以 $S _ { x }$ 的本征值为 $\frac { 3 } { 2 } \hbar , \frac { 1 } { 2 } \hbar , - \frac { 1 } { 2 } \hbar , - \frac { 3 } { 2 } \hbar$ ~ñ

***习题 4.62 推广自旋 $1 / 2$ (方程 (4.145) (4.147)) 、自旋 (习题 4.34) 和自3/2 (习题 4.61) 的情况，求出任意自旋 $s$ 的自旋矩阵.答案:

$$
\boldsymbol {\mathcal {S}} _ {z} = \hbar \left( \begin{array}{c c c c c} s & 0 & 0 & \dots & 0 \\ 0 & s - 1 & 0 & \dots & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & s - 2 & \dots & 0 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & \dots & \vdots \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & - s \end{array} \right),
$$

$$
\boldsymbol {S} _ {x} = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c c c c c c} 0 & b _ {s} & 0 & 0 & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ b _ {s} & 0 & b _ {s - 1} & 0 & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & b _ {s - 1} & 0 & b _ {s - 2} & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & b _ {s - 2} & 0 & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & \dots & \vdots & \vdots \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & 0 & b _ {- s + 1} \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & b _ {- s + 1} & 0 \end{array} \right),
$$

$$
\boldsymbol {\mathcal {S}} _ {y} = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c c c c c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} b _ {s} & 0 & 0 & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ \mathrm {i} b _ {s} & 0 & - \mathrm {i} b _ {s - 1} & 0 & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & \mathrm {i} b _ {s - 1} & 0 & - \mathrm {i} b _ {s - 2} & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & \mathrm {i} b _ {s - 2} & 0 & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & \dots & \vdots & \vdots \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & 0 & - \mathrm {i} b _ {- s + 1} \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & \mathrm {i} b _ {- s + 1} & 0 \end{array} \right),
$$

其中 $b _ { j } \equiv \sqrt { \left( s + j \right) \left( s + 1 - j \right) }$

解答此题是在 $S , S _ { z }$ 的共同表象中求出自旋矩阵的表示.对于任意自旋 $s$ $S _ { z }$ 的取值为 $s \hbar$ ，$( s - 1 ) \hbar$ $( s - 2 ) \hbar$ ，… $- s \hbar$ . $| m \rangle$ 代表 $S _ { z }$ 1i 的态，即 $S _ { z } \left| m \right. = m \hbar \left| m \right.$ 则矩阵元(8:. $\left( S _ { z } \right) _ { n m } =$ $\left. n \right| S _ { z } \left| m \right. = m \hbar \delta _ { n m }$ ，(在自身表象中， $\pmb { S } _ { z }$ 是对角矩阵. )

$$
\boldsymbol {\mathcal {S}} _ {z} = \hbar \left( \begin{array}{c c c c} s & 0 & \dots & 0 \\ 0 & s - 1 & \dots & 0 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\ 0 & 0 & \dots & - s \end{array} \right).
$$

从方程 (4.136)

$$
S _ {\pm} | s m \rangle = \hbar \sqrt {s (s + 1) - m (m \pm 1)} | s m \pm 1 \rangle = \hbar \sqrt {(s \mp m) (s \pm m + 1)} | s m \pm 1 \rangle ,
$$

得矩阵元为

$$
\begin{array}{l} (S _ {+}) _ {n m} = \langle n | S _ {+} | m \rangle = \hbar \sqrt {(s - m) (s + m + 1)} \langle n / m + 1 \rangle \\ = \hbar b _ {m + 1} \delta_ {n, m + 1} = \hbar b _ {n} \delta_ {n, m + 1}, \\ \end{array}
$$

其中 $m$ 代表行号， $n$ 代表列号，并且

$$
b _ {n} \equiv \sqrt {(s - n + 1) (s + n)}.
$$

所以

$$
\boldsymbol {S} _ {+} = \hbar \left( \begin{array}{c c c c c} 0 & b _ {s} & 0 & \dots & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & b _ {s - 1} & \dots & 0 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & b _ {- s + 1} \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & 0 \end{array} \right).
$$

同理

$$
\langle s n | S _ {-} | s m \rangle = \hbar \sqrt {(s + m) (s - m + 1)} \delta_ {n, m - 1} = \hbar b _ {m} \delta_ {n, m - 1}.
$$

所以

$$
\boldsymbol {\mathcal {S}} _ {-} = \hbar \left( \begin{array}{c c c c c} 0 & 0 & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ b _ {s} & 0 & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & b _ {s - 1} & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots & \vdots \\ 0 & 0 & \dots & b _ {- s + 1} & 0 \end{array} \right),
$$

从而得

$$
\boldsymbol {S} _ {x} = \frac {1}{2} \left(\boldsymbol {S} _ {+} + \boldsymbol {S} _ {-}\right) = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c c c c c c} 0 & b _ {s} & 0 & 0 & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ b _ {s} & 0 & b _ {s - 1} & 0 & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & b _ {s - 1} & 0 & b _ {s - 2} & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & b _ {s - 2} & 0 & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots & \vdots \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & 0 & b _ {- s + 1} \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & b _ {- s + 1} & 0 \end{array} \right),
$$

$$
\boldsymbol {S} _ {y} = \frac {1}{2 \mathrm {i}} \left(\boldsymbol {S} _ {+} - \boldsymbol {S} _ {-}\right) = \frac {\hbar}{2 \mathrm {i}} \left( \begin{array}{c c c c c c c} 0 & b _ {s} & 0 & 0 & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ - b _ {s} & 0 & b _ {s - 1} & 0 & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & - b _ {s - 1} & 0 & b _ {s - 2} & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & - b _ {s - 2} & 0 & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots & \vdots \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & 0 & b _ {- s + 1} \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & - b _ {- s + 1} & 0 \end{array} \right).
$$

按如下方法计算球谐函数的归一化因子.从 4.1. 节知串串串习题 4.63

$$
Y _ {\ell} ^ {m} = K _ {\ell} ^ {m} \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} m \phi} P _ {\ell} ^ {m} (\cos \theta);
$$

问题是求出因子 $K _ { \ell } ^ { m }$ (方程 (4.32) 中引用了，但没有推导).用方程 (4.120) (4.121)和(4.130) 得到一个由 $K _ { \ell } ^ { m }$ 表示 $K _ { \ell } ^ { m + 1 }$ 的递推关系式.通过对 $m$ 归纳确定 $K _ { \ell } ^ { m }$ ，使$K _ { \ell } ^ { m }$ 达到一个常数， $C \left( \ell \right) \equiv K _ { \ell } ^ { 0 }$ - 最后，利用习题 4.25 的结果来确定常数大小.关于缔合勒让穗函数的导数，可能会发现以下公式很有用:

$$
\left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) \frac {\mathrm {d} P _ {\ell} ^ {m}}{\mathrm {d} x} = - \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} P _ {\ell} ^ {m} - m x P _ {\ell} ^ {m}.
$$

解答 由习题 4.25

$$
L _ {\pm} Y _ {\ell} ^ {m} = \hbar \sqrt {(\ell \mp m) (\ell \pm m + 1)} Y _ {\ell} ^ {m \pm 1},
$$

$$
L _ {\pm} = \pm \hbar \mathrm {e} ^ {\pm \mathrm {i} \phi} \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} \pm \mathrm {i} \cot \theta \frac {\partial}{\partial \phi}\right).
$$

这里选用 $L _ { + }$ 代入 $Y _ { \ell } ^ { m } = B _ { \ell } ^ { m } \mathrm { e } ^ { \mathrm { i } m \phi } P _ { \ell } ^ { m } \left( \cos \theta \right)$ ，得

$$
\begin{array}{l} \hbar \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \phi} \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} + \mathrm {i} \cot \theta \frac {\partial}{\partial \phi}\right) B _ {\ell} ^ {m} \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} m \phi} P _ {\ell} ^ {m} (\cos \theta) \\ = \hbar \sqrt {(\ell - m) (\ell + m + 1)} B _ {\ell} ^ {m + 1} \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} (m + 1) \phi} P _ {\ell} ^ {m + 1} (\cos \theta) \\ \rightarrow \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} - m \cot \theta\right) B _ {\ell} ^ {m} P _ {\ell} ^ {m} (\cos \theta) = \sqrt {(\ell - m) (\ell + m + 1)} B _ {\ell} ^ {m + 1} P _ {\ell} ^ {m + 1} (\cos \theta). \\ \end{array}
$$

$\cos \theta = x$ 则 ${ \frac { \mathrm { d } } { \mathrm { d } \theta } } = { \frac { \mathrm { d } x } { \mathrm { d } \theta } } { \frac { \mathrm { d } } { \mathrm { d } x } } = - \sin \theta { \frac { \mathrm { d } } { \mathrm { d } x } } = - { \sqrt { 1 - x ^ { 2 } } } { \frac { \mathrm { d } } { \mathrm { d } x } } , \cot \theta = { \frac { x } { \sqrt { 1 - x ^ { 2 } } } }$ ，代入上式，得

$$
B _ {l} ^ {m} \left(- \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} \frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x} - m \frac {x}{\sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}}\right) P _ {\ell} ^ {m} (x) = \sqrt {(\ell - m) (\ell + m + 1)} B _ {\ell} ^ {m + 1} P _ {\ell} ^ {m + 1} (x),
$$

整理，得

$$
- B _ {\ell} ^ {m} \frac {1}{\sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}} \left[ (1 - x ^ {2}) \frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x} P _ {\ell} ^ {m} + m x P _ {\ell} ^ {m} \right] = \sqrt {(\ell - m) (\ell + m + 1)} B _ {\ell} ^ {m + 1} P _ {\ell} ^ {m + 1}.
$$

代入本题所给公式

$$
\left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) \frac {\mathrm {d} P _ {\ell} ^ {m}}{\mathrm {d} x} = - \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} P _ {\ell} ^ {m + 1} - m x P _ {\ell} ^ {m},
$$

得

$$
B _ {\ell} ^ {m} P _ {\ell} ^ {m + 1} = \sqrt {(\ell - m) (\ell + m + 1)} B _ {\ell} ^ {m + 1} P _ {\ell} ^ {m + 1},
$$

所以

$$
B _ {\ell} ^ {m + 1} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {(\ell - m) (\ell + m + 1)}} B _ {\ell} ^ {m}.
$$

当 $m > 0$ 时，

$$
B _ {\ell} ^ {1} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {(\ell - 1) \ell}} B _ {\ell} ^ {0} = \frac {\sqrt {(\ell - 1) !}}{\sqrt {(\ell + 1) !}} B _ {\ell} ^ {0}
$$

$$
B _ {\ell} ^ {2} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {(\ell - 1) (\ell + 2)}} B _ {\ell} ^ {1} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {\ell (\ell + 1) (\ell - 1) (\ell + 2)}} B _ {\ell} ^ {0} = \frac {\sqrt {(\ell - 2) !}}{\sqrt {(\ell + 2) !}} B _ {\ell} ^ {0},
$$

$$
\begin{array}{c c c c c} \cdot & \cdot & \cdot & \cdot & \cdot \\ \cdot & \cdot & \cdot & \cdot & \cdot \end{array}
$$

$$
B _ {\ell} ^ {m} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {(\ell - m + 1) (\ell - m + 2) \cdots (\ell + m)}} B _ {\ell} ^ {0} = \frac {\sqrt {(\ell - m) !}}{\sqrt {(\ell + m) !}} B _ {\ell} ^ {0}.
$$

当 $m < 0$ 时，因为 $B _ { \ell } ^ { - m } = B _ { \ell } ^ { m }$ 所以

$$
B _ {\ell} ^ {m} = \frac {\sqrt {(\ell - | m |) !}}{\sqrt {(\ell + | m |) !}} B _ {\ell} ^ {0},
$$

由习题 4.22 结果知

$$
Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} = \frac {1}{2 ^ {\ell + 1} l !} \sqrt {\frac {(2 \ell + 1) !}{\pi}} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \phi} \sin \theta\right) ^ {\ell} = B _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \ell \phi} P _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} (\cos \theta).
$$

因为

$$
P _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} (x) = (- 1) ^ {\ell} \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) ^ {\ell / 2} \left(\frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x}\right) ^ {\ell} \frac {1}{2 ^ {\ell} \ell !} \left(\frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} x}\right) ^ {\ell} \left(x ^ {2} - 1\right) ^ {\ell} = (- 1) ^ {\ell} \frac {(2 \ell) !}{2 ^ {\ell} \ell !} \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) ^ {\ell / 2},
$$

$$
P _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} (\cos \theta) = (- 1) ^ {\ell} \frac {(2 \ell) !}{2 ^ {\ell} \ell !} (\sin \theta) ^ {\ell},
$$

所以

$$
\begin{array}{l} \frac {(- 1) ^ {\ell}}{2 ^ {\ell + 1} \ell !} \sqrt {\frac {(2 \ell + 1) !}{\pi}} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \phi} \sin \theta\right) ^ {\ell} = (- 1) ^ {\ell} B _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \ell \phi} \frac {(2 \ell) !}{2 ^ {\ell} \ell !} (\sin \theta) ^ {\ell} \\ \Rightarrow B _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} = \sqrt {\frac {2 \ell + 1}{4 \pi (2 \ell) !}} \\ \Rightarrow B _ {\ell} ^ {0} = \sqrt {\frac {2 \ell + 1}{4 \pi}}, \\ \end{array}
$$

因此

$$
B _ {\ell} ^ {m} = \sqrt {\frac {(2 \ell + 1) (\ell - | m |) !}{4 \pi (\ell + | m |) !}}.
$$
